Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 23 (test build)

Release 23 locks a vault whose owner check is overdue, saves its app keys durably, and fixes two recovery edge cases.

Status

Status
Active
Published
2026-10-27
End date
Not set

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • A vault whose daily owner check is overdue now locks itself 7 days (by default) after the check was due, and waits for an answered call to end first. A lock your phone sends is tied to the unlock it follows, so a late lock cannot undo a newer unlock.
  • The vault now saves a new app key only after the host has confirmed the save, and retries a failed save, so a failed save on the host no longer leaves the vault and the phone with different keys.
  • Fix: repeating a recovery after its second step could leave it stuck; the vault now renews the recovered invitation for the same identity. An unlock that finishes a recovery's last step now also ends the recovery record.
  • After a transfer, the vault keeps your old phone's pending unlink until it has been delivered. Staging only: support for a staging test certificate is included but switched off.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit acb007e (tag release/staging/23) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-27 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
